recording.lineage: 2 Nakamichi CM100s/ CP4>Sony WMD6 w/Teac MDX90 (Set 1) & TDK MAR90 (Set 2) cassette masters. No Dolby was used on the Master Cassettes. Front Row Lawn DFC | The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
